verses.1: On that day, Jehovah will bring out from their graves the bodies of the kings of Judah, along with those of their priests and prophets. He will also bring out from their graves the bodies of the people of Jerusalem.
verses.2: And they shall be given to the sun, to the moon, and to all the heavenly armies that love them, and who serve them. They shall also be followed by those who seek them out. But they shall not be gathered or buried in a tomb on the surface of the earth.
verses.3: And death will be chosen from the living, for all those who remain from this evil family. This will happen in all the places where they are left behind. As Jehovah’s army says, “They will be destroyed.”
verses.4: And you said to them, “Thus says the LORD: They will fall and never rise again. They will never return.”
verses.5: Why does this people, who has returned to Jerusalem, still hold onto the false traditions? They should abandon those traditions and return to truth.
verses.6: I listened, but I didn’t hear anything. They said nothing. No one comforted him. They said, “What have I done? All is back to normal now.” Like a bird that has been caught in the net during a battle.
verses.7: Even those who are righteous in heaven will know their time of arrival. They will be able to keep track of it. But my people will not know about Jehovah’s judgment.
verses.8: What shall the wise men say? We are like those who have been deceived by false teachings. Now, behold, they have done a false thing; they have written lies.
verses.9: The wise men were deceived, and they were led astray by the words of Jehovah. They became foolish and stupid.
verses.10: Therefore, I will give their wives to others. Their fields will be given to heirs, from young children to adults. All of them will act in accordance with the commands of the prophets and priests. They all do evil deeds.
verses.11: And they lifted up the daughter of my people on a cross, saying, “Peace! Peace!” But there was no peace.
verses.12: They were punished because they did evil deeds. They also suffered punishment for not doing what they should have done. They knew nothing about this, so they fell into ruin during their time of trouble. They failed, said Jehovah.
verses.13: Let them be gathered together, says Jehovah. There are no grapes on the vine, and there are no figs on the fig tree. Then a storm will come, and I will give them over to it.
verses.14: Why do we gather together and go to the cities of the enemy? There, we will feel that Jehovah our God has shown us His love. But we will be punished by Him because we have sinned against Him.
verses.15: There is no good time for despair; and indeed, there is no good time at all when one is in a state of despair.
verses.16: From the mountains, we heard the loud cries of their horses. The sound was so loud that it filled the entire land. They came and ate up the land and its inhabitants.
verses.17: For I will send upon you serpents that have no venom at all. They will crawl over you, says the LORD.
verses.18: I am overwhelmed with sorrow upon hearing this. It breaks my heart.
verses.19: Now, the cry of my people comes from distant lands. There is no king in Zion; there is no knowledge of him at all. They have angered me with their lies and deceitfulness.
verses.20: The harvest has passed, and we are not saved yet.
verses.21: On the day my people’s daughter was taken away, I lost my strength and vigor.
verses.22: There is no doctor here; there is no one who can heal. For why should one climb the heights of my people?
verses.23: Who will give me water to drink? My eyes are filled with tears. I suffer day and night at the hands of my people’s enemies.
